title: Dependency hygiene: workspace-level deps, retire serde_yaml, align duplicate majors
description:
`serde_yaml = "0.9"` (deprecated and unmaintained) is declared separately in four crates rather than in `[workspace.dependencies]`; `tokio`, `axum`, `tempfile` and `sha2` are also repeated per crate, and apricity-theory declares its own `serde` instead of `serde.workspace`. `Cargo.lock` has 498 packages with duplicate majors: axum 0.7/0.8, hyper 0.14/1, tower 0.4/0.5, rustls 0.21/0.23, thiserror 1/2, sha2 0.10/0.11; apricity-data pins `thiserror = "1"` and the CLI pins `axum = "0.7"` while the Virtuus stack pulls the newer versions. `virtuus-amplify` and `virtuus-appsync` are git dependencies on `branch = "develop"`, pinned only by the lock file. apricity-data needs both `sha1` and `sha2`. The web crate has no `[profile]` section for wasm size or panic behaviour.

Done when: shared deps live at the workspace level; serde_yaml is replaced by a maintained fork or the YAML path is isolated; the duplicate majors are reduced to one where the Virtuus stack allows; the Virtuus git deps point at tags or revs.
